{{Quote|Makkor von Urron was a double TIE ace by age 18, racking up 11 kills against insurgent Y-wings around Oovri II before a lucky shot took out his knee and put him out of action.|''Aces of the Empire''|<ref name="EGTW Author's Cut" />}}
[[Technical Lieutenant]] '''Makkor von Urron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. Makkor von Urron was a TIE [[Ace/Legends|ace]], racking up eleven kills against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] [[Battle of Oovri II|around]] [[Oovri II]]. However, an injury to his knee in the engagement took him out of service. Makkor reinvented himself as a technician working under Technical Services Officer [[Brandei]] of the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], who had handpicked him to lead the fifty-four repair techs serving [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] unit, the 181st. However, Fel convinced him to fly again in his unit.<ref name="EGTW Author's Cut" />
